title: Staleness / review-cadence report (advisory sweep output)
description: The advisory report emitted by scripts/gen-staleness.py (issue #29) — a sweep over the compiled brain (app/brain.json) that flags content needing re-confirmation so decisions and open questions don't silently rot. Each flagged node carries WHY it tripped (`reason`), the rule's window in days (`window_days`), the node's last-touched date (from the git history of its `source` file) and how many days stale it is. Windows/cadence come from client.config.json `staleness` (see config.py defaults); the sweep is gated by features.staleness. ADVISORY, not a hard gate. READ-ONLY: generated, never hand-edited — author the inputs, recompile via `make staleness`. last-touched is git-derived (per-commit-volatile), so this artifact is NOT in the generated-artifact drift gate (the activity.json carve-out).

x-conflict.readonly_reason: compiled advisory report — re-run `make staleness`; git-history-derived, not drift-gated

enabled.description: False when features.staleness is off — the sweep no-ops and the report is empty/quiet.

as_of.description: ISO date the sweep was computed as-of (the reference point for staleness).

windows.description: The effective thresholds (days) the sweep ran with, echoed from config.

source.description: The node's source file — whose git history gives last-touched.

last_touched.description: ISO date the node's source was last touched (git), or null when undeterminable.
